shapes.description: A struct of five fixed-width scalars: the cheapest message.
Mostly text: five strings and a list of six, with non-ASCII characters, a quote and a newline to escape.

fields.string:
Mathematician and writer, chiefly known for her work on Charles Babbage's proposed mechanical general-purpose computer, the Analytical Engine. She was the first to recognise that the machine had applications beyond pure calculation.
Notes: A–G, 1843.

shapes.description: Structs three deep, with options both present and absent at each level.
1000 small structs in one array; element i is {x: 7i - 3500, y: 13i mod 1000, z: -i, weight: 31i mod 65536}.
Unit-variant enums: three fields, an option, and two lists of them.
